import ImbalancedChen.ActualExtendedThirdCompactCellConvergence
import ImbalancedChen.ActualPrimeIcoCellTestFunctions

/-!
# The actual compact-cell harmonic test profile

The prime test measure already contributes one reciprocal of each log
coordinate. The test profile supplies the remaining reciprocal of z.
Its positive clamp is a continuous extension only; it agrees exactly
with the original cell kernel on the actual owned, ordered cell.

Both ordering walls and every Ico ownership boundary are kept in the
arithmetic selector. The strict/weak affine sandwich is pointwise and
does not assume that prime atoms on a wall disappear.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open VariableEnvelope
open scoped Classical BigOperators

def actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile (e h lam : ℝ) (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) : ℝ :=
  4 * (actualExtendedThirdLowerFactor
      ((thirdPrefixTheta - 2 * e - t 0 - t 1 - t 2) / max (h / 2) (t 2)) -
    actualExtendedThirdLowerFactor ((lam - t 0 - t 1 - t 2) / max (h / 2) (t 2))) /
      max (h / 2) (t 2)

theorem continuous_actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile {h : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (e lam : ℝ) :
    Continuous (actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile e h lam) := by
  have hx : Continuous (fun t : Fin 3 → ℝ => t 0) := continuous_apply 0
  have hy : Continuous (fun t : Fin 3 → ℝ => t 1) := continuous_apply 1
  have hz : Continuous (fun t : Fin 3 → ℝ => t 2) := continuous_apply 2
  have hden : Continuous (fun t : Fin 3 → ℝ => max (h / 2) (t 2)) :=
    continuous_const.max hz
  have hne (t : Fin 3 → ℝ) : max (h / 2) (t 2) ≠ 0 :=
    ne_of_gt ((half_pos hh).trans_le (le_max_left _ _))
  unfold actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile
  exact (continuous_const.mul
    ((continuous_actualExtendedThirdLowerFactor.comp
      ((((continuous_const.sub hx).sub hy).sub hz).div hden hne)).sub
        (continuous_actualExtendedThirdLowerFactor.comp
          ((((continuous_const.sub hx).sub hy).sub hz).div hden hne)))).div hden hne

def actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion (m : ℕ)
    (j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m) : Set (Fin 3 → ℝ) :=
  actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j ∩ actualExtendedThirdClosedOrderRegion thirdPrefixRho

theorem measurableSet_actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion (m : ℕ)
    (j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m) :
    MeasurableSet (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j) :=
  (measurableSet_actualExtendedThirdOwnedCell m j).inter
    (measurableSet_actualExtendedThirdClosedOrderRegion thirdPrefixRho)

def actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms : Fin 2 → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  ![ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1 - ContinuousLinearMap.proj 0,
    ContinuousLinearMap.proj 2 - ContinuousLinearMap.proj 1]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms_ne_zero :
    ∀ i, actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms i ≠ 0 := by
  intro i h
  have he := congrArg (fun L : (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ => L ![0, 1, 2]) h
  fin_cases i <;> norm_num [actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms] at he

def actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms : Fin (3 + (3 + 2)) → (Fin 3 → ℝ) →L[ℝ] ℝ :=
  primeIcoBoxGateForms actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms

def actualExtendedThirdCompactCellBounds (m : ℕ) (j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m) :
    Fin (3 + (3 + 2)) → ℝ :=
  primeIcoBoxGateBounds (actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo m j)
    (actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m j) (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0)

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms_ne_zero :
    ∀ i, actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms i ≠ 0 :=
  primeIcoBoxGateForms_ne_zero _ actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms_ne_zero

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion_sandwich {e h : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m) :
    primeAffineGateRegion actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms
        (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellBounds m j) ⊆ actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j ∧
      ∀ t ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j, ∀ i,
        actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms i t ≤ actualExtendedThirdCompactCellBounds m j i := by
  constructor
  · intro t ht
    obtain ⟨hb, hg⟩ := (mem_primeIcoBoxStrictGateRegion
      (actualExtendedThirdDyadicLo m j) (actualExtendedThirdDyadicHi m j)
      actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms (fun _ : Fin 2 => 0) t).mp ht
    have hyx : t 1 < t 0 := by
      have hg0 := hg 0
      change t 1 - t 0 < 0 at hg0
      linarith
    have hzy : t 2 < t 1 := by
      have hg1 := hg 1
      change t 2 - t 1 < 0 at hg1
      linarith
    have hz : 0 < t 2 := hh.trans_le ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans (hb 2).1.le)
    have hxrho : t 0 ≤ thirdPrefixRho :=
      (hb 0).2.le.trans (actualExtendedThirdDyadic_bounds m j 0).2.2
    have hzrho : t 2 ≤ thirdPrefixRho := (hzy.le.trans hyx.le).trans hxrho
    exact ⟨⟨fun i _ => ⟨(hb i).1.le, (hb i).2⟩, ⟨hz.le, hzy.le, hyx.le⟩⟩,
      ⟨hz, hzrho, hzy.le, hyx.le, hxrho⟩⟩
  · intro t ht
    simp only [actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms, actualExtendedThirdCompactCellBounds,
      primeIcoBoxGateForms, primeIcoBoxGateBounds, Fin.forall_fin_add,
      Fin.append_left, Fin.append_right, neg_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply,
      neg_le_neg_iff]
    refine ⟨fun i => (ht.1.1 i (mem_univ _)).1,
      fun i => (ht.1.1 i (mem_univ _)).2.le, ?_⟩
    intro i
    fin_cases i <;>
      simp only [actualExtendedThirdCompactOrderForms, Matrix.cons_val_zero,
        Matrix.cons_val_one, ContinuousLinearMap.sub_apply, ContinuousLinearMap.proj_apply] <;>
      linarith [ht.2.2.2.1, ht.2.2.2.2.1]

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion_subset_cube {e h : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j ⊆
      logPrimeBox (fun _ : Fin 3 => h / 2) (fun _ => thirdPrefixRho + 1) := by
  intro t ht
  have hz : h ≤ t 2 := (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans (ht.1.1 2 (mem_univ _)).1
  have hlow (i : Fin 3) : h ≤ t i := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact (hz.trans ht.2.2.2.1).trans ht.2.2.2.2.1
    · exact hz.trans ht.2.2.2.1
    · exact hz
  have hhigh (i : Fin 3) : t i ≤ thirdPrefixRho := by
    fin_cases i
    · exact ht.2.2.2.2.2
    · exact ht.2.2.2.2.1.trans ht.2.2.2.2.2
    · exact (ht.2.2.2.1.trans ht.2.2.2.2.1).trans ht.2.2.2.2.2
  apply mem_logPrimeBox.mpr
  intro i
  exact ⟨(by linarith : h / 2 ≤ h).trans (hlow i),
    (hhigh i).trans_lt (by linarith)⟩

theorem actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile_density {e h lam : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) {t : Fin 3 → ℝ}
    (ht : t ∈ actualExtendedThirdClosedOrderRegion thirdPrefixRho) (hz : h ≤ t 2) :
    actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile e h lam t * (∏ i : Fin 3, 1 / t i) =
      actualExtendedThirdCapKernel e lam (t 0) (t 1) (t 2) := by
  have hx0 : t 0 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (ht.1.trans_le (ht.2.2.1.trans ht.2.2.2.1))
  have hy0 : t 1 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt (ht.1.trans_le ht.2.2.1)
  have hz0 : t 2 ≠ 0 := ne_of_gt ht.1
  have hfield (A : ℝ) :
      (4 * A / t 2) * (∏ i : Fin 3, 1 / t i) = 4 * A / (t 0 * t 1 * t 2 ^ 2) := by
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_three]
    field_simp [hx0, hy0, hz0]
    <;> ring
  unfold actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile actualExtendedThirdCapKernel
  simp only [max_eq_right (by linarith : h / 2 ≤ t 2)]
  exact hfield _

end

end ImbalancedChen

import ImbalancedChen.ActualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile

/-!
# Actual prime harmonic sums for the fixed-cutoff cell policy

Every summand is the literal prime-box test with the actual owned ordered
cell and actual physical cell level. Its limit is the previously proved
integrable cell cap kernel. Only finite sums are interchanged.

The final tolerance chooses the cutoff, positive buffer and finite grid
before N. This is a prime harmonic mean, not yet an identification with
the signed arithmetic first-exit sieve density or its counting error.
-/

namespace ImbalancedChen

noncomputable section

open Set Filter Topology MeasureTheory
open VariableEnvelope
open scoped Classical BigOperators

def actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum (N : ℕ) (e h : ℝ) (m : ℕ)
    (j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m) : ℝ :=
  actualPrimeBoxTestSum N (fun _ : Fin 3 => h / 2) (fun _ => thirdPrefixRho + 1)
    ((actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j).indicator
      (actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile e h (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j)))

theorem tendsto_actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum {e h : ℝ} {m : ℕ}
    (hh : 0 < h) {j : ActualExtendedThirdDyadicLabel m}
    (hj : j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum N e h m j) atTop
      (𝓝 (actualExtendedThirdRetainedCellIntegral e m j)) := by
  have hhrho : h ≤ thirdPrefixRho :=
    (Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans
      ((actualExtendedThirdDyadic_bounds m j 2).2.1.le.trans
        (actualExtendedThirdDyadic_bounds m j 2).2.2)
  have hab : h / 2 < thirdPrefixRho + 1 := by linarith
  have hsand := actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion_sandwich hh hj
  have hlim := tendsto_actualPrimeBoxTestSum_cube_affineSandwich (half_pos hh) hab
    actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellBounds m j)
    actualExtendedThirdCompactCellForms_ne_zero (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j)
    (measurableSet_actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j) hsand.1 hsand.2
    (actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile e h (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j))
    (continuous_actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile hh e
      (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j)).continuousOn
  have hdomain : logPrimeBox (fun _ : Fin 3 => h / 2) (fun _ => thirdPrefixRho + 1) ∩
      actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j = actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j :=
    inter_eq_right.mpr (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion_subset_cube hh hj)
  have hintegral :
      (∫ t in logPrimeBox (fun _ : Fin 3 => h / 2) (fun _ => thirdPrefixRho + 1) ∩
          actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j,
        actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile e h (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j) t *
          ∏ i : Fin 3, 1 / t i) = actualExtendedThirdRetainedCellIntegral e m j := by
    rw [hdomain]
    change (∫ t in actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j,
      actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile e h (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j) t *
        ∏ i : Fin 3, 1 / t i) =
      ∫ t in actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j,
        actualExtendedThirdCapKernel e (actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel e m j) (t 0) (t 1) (t 2)
    apply setIntegral_congr_fun (measurableSet_actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeRegion m j)
    intro t ht
    exact actualExtendedThirdCompactHarmonicProfile_density hh ht.2
      ((Finset.mem_filter.mp hj).2.trans (ht.1.1 2 (mem_univ _)).1)
  simpa only [actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum, hintegral] using hlim

def actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum (N : ℕ) (e h : ℝ) (m : ℕ) : ℝ :=
  ∑ j ∈ actualExtendedThirdCompactCells e h m, actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum N e h m j

theorem tendsto_actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum {e h : ℝ}
    (hh : 0 < h) (he0 : 0 ≤ e) (he : e ≤ 1 / 384) (m : ℕ) :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ => actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum N e h m) atTop
      (𝓝 (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellFunctional e h m)) := by
  rw [actualExtendedThirdCompactCellFunctional_eq_sum_cells he0 he m]
  exact tendsto_finsetSum _ (fun _j hj => tendsto_actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum hh hj)

/-- The finite actual prime tests recover the same manuscript functional.
All policy parameters precede the sufficiently large arithmetic target. -/
theorem exists_actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum_approx_ideal {ε : ℝ} (hε : 0 < ε) :
    ∃ h : ℝ, 0 < h ∧ ∃ e : ℝ, 0 < e ∧ e ≤ 1 / 384 ∧ ∃ m : ℕ,
      ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
        |actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum N e h m - actualExtendedThirdIdealFunctional| ≤ ε := by
  obtain ⟨h, hh, e₀, he₀, he₀cap, m₀, hb⟩ :=
    actualExtendedThirdCompactCellFunctional_uniform_approx (half_pos hε)
  have hepos : 0 < e₀ / 2 := half_pos he₀
  have hecap : e₀ / 2 ≤ 1 / 384 := (by linarith : e₀ / 2 ≤ e₀).trans he₀cap
  have hcont : |actualExtendedThirdCompactCellFunctional (e₀ / 2) h m₀ -
      actualExtendedThirdIdealFunctional| ≤ ε / 2 :=
    hb (e₀ / 2) hepos.le (by linarith) m₀ le_rfl
  have hprime : ∀ᶠ N : ℕ in atTop,
      |actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum N (e₀ / 2) h m₀ -
        actualExtendedThirdCompactCellFunctional (e₀ / 2) h m₀| < ε / 2 := by
    simpa only [Real.dist_eq] using Metric.tendsto_nhds.mp
      (tendsto_actualExtendedThirdCompactPrimeSum hh hepos.le hecap m₀)
        (ε / 2) (half_pos hε)
  refine ⟨h, hh, e₀ / 2, hepos, hecap, m₀, ?_⟩
  filter_upwards [hprime] with N hN
  apply (abs_sub_le _ (actualExtendedThirdCompactCellFunctional (e₀ / 2) h m₀) _).trans
  exact (add_le_add hN.le hcont).trans (by linarith)

end

end ImbalancedChen

sourceDAG_delta.basis: Root supplied both direct parent modules as already owned; their exact current hashes were freshly checked. Each new leaf imports only those parents or the other new leaf.

pointwise_wall_sandwich_audit: The actual arithmetic region is OwnedCell(m,j) intersect ClosedOrderRegion(rho). OwnedCell is a product of Ico coordinate intervals intersect the closed order; the indicator therefore retains all lower-face ownership, excludes the upper faces, and retains the y=x and z=y order walls.

Eight strict affine rows encode lo_i<t_i<hi_i for three coordinates and t1<t0, t2<t1. Their strict region is proved pointwise to lie in the actual region using the selected positive third lower endpoint and the dyadic rho bound.

Every actual-region point satisfies every corresponding weak affine inequality: closed lower coordinate bounds, weak versions of actual strict upper bounds, and both weak order inequalities. This includes all arithmetic atoms lying on coordinate or ordering walls.

The already owned ActualPrimeIcoCellTestFunctions theorem proves the strict/weak ramp sandwich pointwise for the actual prime sum. Only the continuous integral uses null affine walls. The new leaves do not assume that prime atoms on a wall disappear.
kernel_density_audit: The continuous profile denominator is max(h/2,z), everywhere at least h/2>0. This gives a genuine continuous extension on the whole finite-dimensional real space.
On every selected compact cell, h<=cellLo_2<=z. Thus max(h/2,z)=z exactly. ClosedOrderRegion supplies 0<z<=y<=x, so all reciprocal coordinate denominators are nonzero.

The actual prime test limiting measure contributes product_i(1/t_i)=1/(x*y*z). Multiplying the profile 4*(LowerFactor((Theta-2e-x-y-z)/z)-LowerFactor((lam-x-y-z)/z))/z gives exactly the original CapKernel denominator x*y*z^2.

The cell physical level remains the actualExtendedThirdPhysicalLevel(e,m,j). The clamping used for continuity is removed by an exact pointwise identity on the retained arithmetic/integration region, not by an approximation.
arithmetic_to_ideal_audit: actualExtendedThirdCompactCellPrimeSum is the actualPrimeBoxTestSum with weight product_i 1/(p_i-1), on the fixed cube [h/2,rho+1)^3, and with the exact owned ordered-cell indicator times the actual harmonic profile.

Each selected region lies in that cube: all coordinates are >=h and <=rho. The owned affine-sandwich prime theorem applies with the true continuous profile and nonzero affine rows. Its limiting integral is converted pointwise to the literal retained-cell cap-kernel integral.

For every fixed h>0, every fixed 0<=e<=1/384 and every fixed finite mesh m, the finite sum over selected cells converges to the existing CompactCellFunctional(e,h,m). Only finite sums are interchanged.

The final tolerance theorem invokes the owned uniform continuous approximation with epsilon/2, fixes h, chooses positive e=e0/2<=1/384, and fixes m=m0 before N tends to infinity. Prime convergence contributes the other epsilon/2, giving the same existing actualExtendedThirdIdealFunctional.

The final statement is existence of h,e,m before the eventual-N threshold, not a uniform arithmetic threshold valid simultaneously for every varying h,e,m. It establishes a prime harmonic mean only; no signed first-exit sieve density, arithmetic counting-error cancellation, or old-weight identification is claimed.
